Takeaways
Revenue
-- $1.234 billion for the fiscal year, up 32% year over year.
Q4 revenue
-- $350 million, representing 30% year-over-year growth, with annualized run rate now $1.4 billion.
Non-GAAP operating margin
-- 14% for the year and 15% in Q4, expanding 170 basis points and 900 basis points, respectively.
Free cash flow
-- $87 million in Q4, up 61% year over year; free cash flow margin was 16% for the year.
Customer metrics
-- 193,000+ customers in over 100 countries; customers with over $50,000 in ARR rose 37% to 3,912, with 349 net new additions in the cohort.
Net revenue retention (NRR)
-- 110% for the year, expanding over 200 basis points.
International revenue growth
-- 42% for the year; Q4 international revenue led by Italy grew 41% year over year and now exceeds one-third of total business.
Product adoption
-- 60% of ARR from multiproduct customers; over 15% of ARR from customers adopting at least three products.
AI engagement
-- More than half of campaigns by marketing agent users are AI-generated, performing as well or better than manual campaigns and reducing campaign creation time.
Enterprise pipeline
-- The number of customers generating at least $1 million ARR doubled in the year, supported by new partnerships and expanded leadership in enterprise sales.
Text and WhatsApp usage
-- 29% of SMB plus customers utilize text and WhatsApp; WhatsApp launch contributed to international adoption trends.
Guidance
-- Raised 2026 revenue outlook to $1.501 billion-$1.509 billion, representing 21.5%-22.5% projected growth, with a non-GAAP operating margin guidance of 14.5%-15%.
Platform scale
-- Processed half a trillion customer interactions annually, with 3.7 billion daily signals across 8 billion consumer profiles.
Q1 2026 expectations
-- Revenue between $346 million and $350 million (23.5%-25% growth), non-GAAP operating income of $50 million-$53 million; seasonality and product ramps expected to weight revenue to the year’s second half.
Operational expenses
-- Non-GAAP operating expenses were 58% of revenue, the lowest level since IPO, attributed to AI-driven internal productivity gains.

Industry glossary
Klaviyo Attributed Value (KAV)
: Metric representing incremental revenue generated for customers as a result of engagement activities run through the Klaviyo platform.
MCP server
: Klaviyo's integration tool that connects external models or agents with first-party data and messaging infrastructure.
NRR (Net Revenue Retention)
: Measures year over year recurring revenue growth from existing customers, including upgrades, downgrades, and churn.
ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue)
: The value of contracted recurring revenue from customers, annualized.
